scripts.install:frozen: bun install --frozen-lockfile && python -m pip install --require-hashes -r server/modules/requirements-dev.lock
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: bun test protocol server client && python -m pytest server/modules/prompt_enhancer
scripts.test:protocol: bun test protocol server/config.test.ts server/lib/auth.test.ts server/lib/ws.test.ts server/lib/scheduler.test.ts client/lib/ws.test.ts client/events/fileop.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
